title: Regretting You
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: A mother and her teenage daughter, who have never quite understood one another, are thrown together by a sudden loss and a betrayal that forces them to look at each of their relationships again.
readIf: you want a family-focused Hoover with a mother-daughter relationship at its centre.
skipIf: you need a romance-only story; this splits attention between two generations.

pairings.reason: Another mix of family secrets, school-community drama and women supporting each other.
A mother-daughter, suburban story about secrets and choices, with a literary edge.
Another Hoover novel where one tragedy ripples through a family and a town.
